methodology.warm: Two ABBA rounds per case; median of four independent process medians, each containing seven correlated measured intervals divided by completed calls. No samples discarded.
methodology.first: Six ABBA rounds per case; 12 independent first completed calls per variant. Interpolated p95 is descriptive at this small sample size, not a tail-latency qualification.
methodology.process_cpu: Raw process CPU retained; short intervals show counter quantization, so a recorded zero is unresolved below resolution, never zero CPU work.
methodology.storage: Instrumentation shallow object sizes of actual retained structural metadata in separate JVMs; no agent or instrumentation in timed JVMs. APK/parsed objects, shared strings, native heaps and process footprint excluded.
methodology.interference: One reported approximately 3.8-second evidence-only Python enumeration during final warm run. Conservative 11:49:30–11:50:30 UTC interval and all 184 derived process intervals retained; no receipt removed. First-query run had no reported overlap.
